name: Claude Agent SDK TypeScript Reference Adapter
summary: Governed read-only reference adapter for the official TypeScript SDK.

example.title: Claude Agent SDK TypeScript Reference Adapter
example.summary: Read-only one-shot adapter with explicit tool, data, redaction, and receipt boundaries.
example.integrationBoundary: The SDK executes the agent loop; pwcli-core fixtures and adapter code own intent, policy, redaction, tool gates, and receipt shape.
example.notes: Provider API traffic is required. Agent tools have no network or mutation capability; host isolation remains a separate control.
